hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/claims.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; py=python; command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1 || py=python3; in=$(cat); if ! printf '%s' "$in" | "$py" "$f" hook; then case "$in" in *merge*|*Merge*) echo "claims: the claims hook could not run, so the merge is refused (fail closed)" >&2; exit 2;; esac; fi
